Blank sheet.

Na tela inicial, clique em <b>Novo desen: On the start screen, click New drawing. The grid sheet is the drawing area: each little square is a few centimeters of the building, and the measurements come out right on their own.
Escolha a ferramenta na coluna da esquer: Pick a tool in the column on the left and draw on the sheet. To see a finished drawing, open the example on the start screen.
<b>Viga</b>: clique onde ela começa e ar: Beam: click where it starts and drag to where it ends. Each beam gets a name (BEAM 1, BEAM 2…). Beams stay straight, horizontal or vertical; hold Shift to make a slanted one.
<b>Pilar</b>: clique para colocar. Ele e: Column: click to place it. It snaps to the ends, corners and middle of the beams. The R key turns the column upright or sideways before you place it.
<b>Medida</b>: arraste do começo ao fim: Dimension: drag from the start to the end of what you want to measure. The value is calculated and written for you; then drag the middle dot to move the dimension line away.
<b>Texto</b>: clique onde ele vai ficar,: Text: click where it goes, type and press Enter. Line and Rectangle are for stairs, openings, slabs and details.
Com a ferramenta <b>Selecionar</b>, cliq: With the Select tool, click a drawing to select it. The panel on the right shows the exact measurements: type the right length (for example, 3.50 m) and the drawing follows.
Arraste para mover. Arraste as bolinhas: Drag to move. Drag the dots at the ends to stretch or shorten. Drag the name of a beam or column to move it off another drawing. Double-click to change a name or text.
Cada desenho pode ter a sua cor (as pron: Each drawing can have its own color (the ready-made ones or Other color…) and thickness. With nothing selected, the panel shows the drawing settings: text size, measurements in meters or centimeters and the automatic names (change BEAM and C to another word, or leave them empty).
Errou? <b>Ctrl+Z</b> desfaz (quantas vez: Made a mistake? Ctrl+Z undoes (as many times as you need) and Ctrl+Y redoes. The Eraser deletes whatever you click.
<b>Salvar</b> guarda o desenho num arqui: Save keeps the drawing in a .cadinho file, so you can continue later. Saved drawings show up on the start screen with a thumbnail.
Enquanto você desenha, o Autocadinho gua: While you draw, Autocadinho keeps a backup copy. If the computer shuts down before you save, it offers to recover the drawing the next time it opens.
<b>Imprimir</b> mostra a folha como vai: Print shows the sheet as it will come out. Choose the paper (A4, A3, A2, Letter or Brazilian legal), the orientation and the scale: "Fit to page" uses the whole sheet; with an exact scale, such as 1:50, you can measure on paper with a ruler (1 cm = 50 cm). From there you can also save as PDF or as an image, to send by email or WhatsApp.

Clique num desenho para escolher e arras: Click a drawing to select it and drag to move it. Drag the dots to change its size. Double-click to change a name or text. The Delete key erases.
Traço grosso com nome: vigas, paredes, m: A thick stroke with a name: beams, walls, fences. Click where it starts and drag to where it ends. It gets a name on its own (BEAM 1, BEAM 2…). Then type the exact length here on the side.
Para escadas, aberturas, paredes finas e: For stairs, openings, thin walls and details. Click and drag. It can be dashed.
Bloco cheio com nome: pilares, sapatas,: A solid block with a name: columns, footings, boxes. Click to place it; it snaps to the ends and middle of the beams. The R key turns the block upright or sideways.
Clique num canto e arraste até o canto o: Click a corner and drag to the opposite corner. Good for slabs, openings and areas.
Clique e arraste do começo ao fim do que: Click and drag from the start to the end of what you want to measure: the value is calculated for you. Then drag the middle dot to move the dimension line away.
Clique onde o texto vai ficar, escreva e: Click where the text goes, type and press Enter.
Clique no que quer apagar, ou arraste po: Click what you want to erase, or drag over several. Made a mistake? Ctrl+Z undoes it.
Drag to see another part of the drawing. The mouse wheel zooms in and out.
Os desenhos encaixam nos pontos da grade: Drawings snap to grid points spaced this many centimeters apart.
Cada viga ou pilar novo ganha o próximo: Each new beam or column gets the next number (BEAM 1, BEAM 2… or C1, C2…). Change the word (WALL, FOOTING…) or leave it empty to draw without names.
As letras valem para os nomes das vigas: The text size applies to beam and column names and to dimensions.
Voltar o nome para o lugar automático: Put the name back in its automatic place
Deixe \"Escrever\" vazio para mostrar a: Leave "Show as" empty to show the calculated measurement.
